name: Halloween
hook: The October holiday, from Carpenter's slasher to candy corn and Houdini's seances.

facts.label: the 1978 film
facts.statement: Halloween is John Carpenter's 1978 thriller, working title 'The Babysitter Murders,' with Jamie Lee Curtis as Laurie Strode and Michael Myers as the killer.

facts.label: Monster Mash
facts.statement: Bobby 'Boris' Pickett's 'Monster Mash' was a 1962 Halloween hit, a 'graveyard smash' that charted again in 1973.

facts.label: candy corn
facts.statement: Candy corn is the tri-colored Halloween staple with its own national day on October 30.

facts.label: the pumpkin
facts.statement: Pumpkins are carved into jack-o'-lanterns, though the Scots and Irish once used turnips instead.

facts.label: Harry Houdini
facts.statement: Harry Houdini died on Halloween in 1926, and his widow Bess held annual seances to try to contact him.

facts.label: trick or treat
facts.statement: Trick-or-treating descends from children asking for food in exchange for prayers for the dead.

facts.label: the Great Pumpkin
facts.statement: Linus waits every Halloween for the Great Pumpkin in the Peanuts special.
